title: Walnut cut
description: Warm walnut changes from end-grain rings to lengthwise growth as the cut turns.
useCase: Compare directional material grain through an adjustable cut plane.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. Procedural growth-ring approximation with pores; no scanned wood texture or species-accurate anatomy.
look: Full-bleed warm orange-brown walnut surface with dark wavy concentric growth rings around an off-centre pith, fine vertical fibre streaks and pores.
motion: A soft warm sheen drifts side to side across the wood on a roughly 35 s sine; the cut-angle slider tilts the slicing plane, stretching end-grain rings into lengthwise stripes.
adapt: The `FRAGMENT` shader does everything: `grain` tilts the sampling plane by `u_control` and returns ring radius, `fract(r*24.)` sets ring density, and `reflection` is the moving sheen. Recolour the earlywood and latewood tones in `col`; keep the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
